class.name: AudioPacketDecoder
class.brief_description: Decodes compressed audio frames that arrive one by one (AAC with its ADTS header) to stereo frames.

method.name: decode
method.description: Decodes one packet. Returns its frames as stereo at [method get_output_rate] (empty for a damaged packet, which is counted in [method get_stats], or while the resampler fills).

method.name: flush
method.description: Drops what the decoder and the resampler hold, so after a gap nothing old comes out first.

method.name: get_channels
method.description: The stream's channels, once a packet has decoded (0 before).

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Why [method open] failed, or why the resampler couldn't be made.

method.name: get_output_rate
method.description: The rate of the frames [method decode] returns.

method.name: get_sample_rate
method.description: The stream's own rate, once a packet has decoded (0 before).

method.name: is_open
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] between a successful [method open] and [method close].

method.name: open
method.description: Opens FFmpeg's decoder of that name (any audio decoder of the build that needs no extradata; AAC reads the ADTS header of each frame). [param output_rate] 0: the [AudioServer]'s mix rate.
